name: finance-bench-stock-predictions
description: A benchmark for predicting stock movements and/or prices using historical market data and optionally auxiliary signals (news, fundamentals). It measures models' ability to forecast next-step prices or directional changes and to produce actionable predictions under realistic financial evaluation. Tasks typically include both regression (price prediction) and classification (directional accuracy).
evaluation_method: RMSE (for price prediction) / accuracy (for directional prediction)
reputation: A niche but useful dataset for financial time‑series and news-informed prediction research; modest community adoption compared with mainstream ML benchmarks.
